perks.name: Slideshot
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting

enhanced.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.

perks.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

enhanced.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a longer duration.

perks.name: Permeability
perks.description: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon.

enhanced.name: Permeability
enhanced.description: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon. Improves handling.

perks.name: Reverberation

enhanced.name: Reverberation
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for an improved duration.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

enhanced.name: High Ground
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.

perks.name: Harmony

enhanced.name: Harmony
